observations: All eight rounds and all four abrupt-process recovery fixtures passed independent mechanical verification; all 14 aggregate checks passed.
PERSIST reduced pooled image/API median from 3.6559 to 3.3505 ms and execute median from 0.0542 to 0.0428 ms in this fixture.
PERSIST did not improve pooled commit median: DELETE 1.6808 ms versus PERSIST 1.8110 ms. Commit p99 was 2.6128 versus 2.6768 ms.

Long commit tails remained in both conditions: DELETE maximum 78.4110 ms in display round 5; PERSIST maximum 41.0513 ms in display round 7. These observed maxima do not establish tail-probability or host-lag improvement.

All rounds observed a 425984-byte database and 25136-byte rollback-journal maximum. Largest observed combined native footprint was 434736 bytes for DELETE and 451120 bytes for PERSIST; component maxima need not occur simultaneously.

decision.authority: Root campaign engineering decision after authenticated completed evidence
decision.reason: Modest fixture API/execute overhead benefit does not establish host tail-latency improvement or production quota coverage; commit tails persist, and typical commit latency is not better. Keep the qualified production behavior unchanged and proceed with full qualification.
decision.production_sqlite_policy: DELETE plus FULL, unchanged from dev009 production lineage
decision.next_step: Proceed with required final native, boundary and model qualification against the unchanged dev009 production lineage; carry prior failures and limitations forward.

limitations: One fixed counterbalanced eight-round run on one Windows environment, lasting about 21.5 seconds; no replicated estimate of rare-event probability or generalized performance effect.

The 64-by-48 synthetic inputs and 416 KiB database are much smaller than the long-running native host workload; no physics, model inference, live gateway or simultaneous protected/public host journal publication was exercised.

All retained Reader content is independently decoded and verified. Full-input and all-encoded-pair digests are source-bound producer observations compared across rounds; discarded image bytes cannot be independently replayed.

API timings contain nested native SQL calls and instrumentation/accounting overhead. SQL durations exclude their pre/post file census. Categories must not be summed; pooled summaries are descriptive and do not make individual operations independent experimental replications.
Observed boundary file maxima are not continuous transient peak measurements or a hard OS quota. The small fixture does not qualify production journal reserve or larger quotas.
Process termination before/after commit tests recovery on exact copies; it is not a power-loss or physical-storage durability certificate.

No performance-win or adoption threshold was predeclared. The decision not to adopt is engineering judgment about demonstrated benefit, remaining tails and integration scope, not a failed mechanical gate.
The passing probe 004 remains valid/unknown, and the invalid probe 003 and earlier non-CPU smoke stall remain unresolved historical evidence. This benchmark does not prove those stalls fixed.
